scenes.hook: What Are H T M L Tags?. Let’s make it simple.
scenes.idea: Tags describe the role of content on a web page. Start by understanding the role it plays in a page.
scenes.code: Most elements have an opening tag, content, and a closing tag. Read the example from top to bottom.
scenes.result: Here’s an illustration of the result. Compare it with the example you just saw. Small changes in code can change the output.
scenes.tip: A slash marks the closing tag. Keep this detail in mind when writing your own example.
scenes.caution: Void elements, like images, have no closing tag in H T M L. Understanding this helps you avoid a common beginner mistake.
scenes.try: Write a paragraph element containing your name. Change one part, then compare your result.
scenes.close: Like, share, and subscribe for more web development basics.
